task_summary: Read problem.json, execute 5 JAX computation tasks (row mean, element-wise square, logistic loss gradient, RNN scan, JIT MLP), and save outputs as .npy files.
decomposition_rationale: The task involves a straightforward pipeline: load data, compute with JAX, save results. All 5 problems share the same I/O pattern but differ in JAX computation. A two-skill decomposition separates data I/O concerns from the JAX computation logic, keeping the solution clean without over-decomposing.

skills.name: evo-jax-io
skills.description: Handles loading problem.json, reading .npy/.npz input files into JAX arrays, and saving JAX array results back to .npy files with proper numpy conversion.
skills.responsibility: All file I/O: parsing problem.json, loading numpy/npz data files and converting to JAX arrays, and safely serializing JAX arrays to .npy output files using np.asarray().
dr_sections: 1. Data Loading Patterns for JAX Workflows
1.2 Dtype Conversion Pitfalls and Default Precision
7. Data Serialization: Saving JAX Arrays to NumPy Files

skills.name: evo-jax-compute
skills.description: Implements all five JAX computation tasks: row-wise mean reduction, element-wise squaring, logistic loss gradient via jax.grad, RNN forward pass via jax.lax.scan, and JIT-compiled 2-layer MLP forward pass.
skills.responsibility: All JAX computation logic for the five problem tasks, dispatching by problem ID and returning JAX arrays as results.
dr_sections: 8. Common Pitfalls and Migration Notes in JAX 0.8.x
